description: Change when a machine is removed automatically (ISO 8601, UTC). It bills until then, and removal deletes the machine and its disk. Use it to end a rental early when the job will finish sooner, or, with a token that has no spend cap, to extend a long run. A token with a spend cap can only move removal earlier.

at.description: When to remove it, for example 2026-10-13T18:00:00Z.

name: schedule_removal
title: Schedule removal
